logic.note: Off without base current; on (active) with collector current = hFE × base current; saturated (Vce ≈ 0.2 V) when the load cannot take that much.

timing.note: Instant with each re-solve; no storage time (a saturated BJT turns off a few hundred ns late).

analog.note: Base-emitter as a 0.65 V diode (+ ~25 Ω), collector current hFE × Ib in the active region, a 0.2 V collector-emitter drop when saturated. hFE fixed per model (2N2222 150, BC547 290), real parts spread 100 to 800.

power.note: Warns above the collector-current rating and reports Vce × Ic heating above 0.6 W (TO-92); the part does not fail.

emulates: Switching a load from a GPIO through a base resistor
doesNotEmulate: Exponential Vbe curve, Early effect, temperature drift
testOnRealDevice: hFE varies 3× between parts: give the base 2-3× the current you computed
